item.title: Hotel of Terror holding petition event after eminent domain vote
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — The owner of the Hotel of Terror is asking Springfield residents to help challenge the city’s plan to take control of the property through eminent domain. item.title: Missouri Attorney General issues investigation into cryptocurrency kiosks
item.description: JEFFERSON CITY, Mo. — The Missouri Attorney General has announced that her office has begun a statewide investigation into companies using cryptocurrency kiosks attempting to defraud consumers. According to a press release from the general's office, Catherine Hanaway has launched the investigation due to national concerns of deceptive fee structures and use by bad actors [...]

item.title: Springfield business owner federally indicted for COVID-19 loan fraud, money laundering
item.description: Jason L. Hemingway was indicted in federal court for allegedly obtaining $316,062 through fraudulent Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) loans in 2021 and laundering more than $35,000.

item.title: Springfield Skateland suffers $80K loss in major theft
